title: Grateful Dead Live at Avalon Ballroom on 1966-05-19
source: SBD > Reel > DAT > Sonic Solutions > DAT > DAT > CDR

ai_review.summary: Soundboard capture of early material with a decent mix—some listeners love its clarity while others miss the extra bass found in FM radio versions.
ai_review.review: The recording is praised by at least one reviewer for its superior sound quality and mix, especially when compared to other releases of this May 19, 1966 show. Another listener feels the FM‑radio feed has more low end, indicating the bass may be a bit thin here. No specific comments on the performance itself were offered beyond noting the historical importance of the early set.

ai_rating.rationale: Reviews are split between high (5‑star) and low (0‑2‑star) ratings, with little detail on the musical performance; recording quality is judged as good but not universally praised.

recording_quality.technical_notes: One reviewer notes less bass and lower levels compared to FM radio, while another praises the mix and overall sound quality.

show_quality.setlist_flow: No specific comments on song performance or set pacing; reviewers focus mainly on audio characteristics and historical significance.
